tasks.title: Official Antigravity Zero-G Glass UI & 2x2 SSAA Retina PNG Icons
tasks.description: Render the floating delta-prism Antigravity SVG glyph and programmatically generate 180x180, 192x192, and 512x512 Retina PNG icons on #07080C Deep Void Obsidian.
tasks.spec: Pure Node.js CRC32 + Zlib IDAT PNG encoder with 2x2 Supersampling Anti-Aliasing and Brave iOS visualViewport pinning.
acceptanceCriteria: Inline SVG logo rendered in top bar, login hero, and empty watermark.

tasks.title: Zero-Config Gemini Profile Hydration & 7 MCP Auto-Discovery
tasks.description: Automatically introspect ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md, mcp_config.json, hooks.json, and all 4 colocated Vast.ai workspaces on login.
tasks.spec: Parallel 900ms health probes across :8787, :7861, :4001, and :4002 plus hydrated Slash Prompt Chips.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-discovers AntigravityRemote, RemoveBackGround, BinaryDay, and SnapCal.
Surfaces all 7 MCP servers (Vast.ai, Cloudflare, OVH, GitHub, Stitch, Resend, Stripe).

tasks.title: Real Workspace Tool Execution & One-Tap Antigravity Rollbacks
tasks.description: Execute read_file, edit_file, write_file, and run_command via gemini-3.5-flash with pre-turn #cp-xxxxxx file snapshots and one-tap Rollback to here.
tasks.spec: Snapshot modified files prior to write and restore in reverse chronological order on POST /api/projects/:id/rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping Rollback restores modified files and rewinds prompt into composer.

tasks.title: User Profile Security Markers Bar & 30-Minute Inactivity Auto-Logout
tasks.description: Display authenticated user login (jbb@avilo.capital), TLS/JWT security markers, and enforce a 30-minute (1800s) sliding inactivity auto-logout.
tasks.spec: Dual client countdown + server sessionRegistry sliding 1800s expiration with manual Lock button.
acceptanceCriteria: Security bar displays user identity, TLS 1.3 marker, and live 30:00 countdown.
Session automatically revokes and locks after 30 minutes of inactivity.

tasks.title: Interactive File Diff Viewer Modal on Checkpoint Cards
tasks.description: Allow tapping the (N files snapshotted) badge on any turn card to preview unified before/after code diffs on Brave iOS before deciding to rollback.
tasks.spec: Render a Zero-G Glass diff modal comparing originalContent vs newContent from checkpoint.modifiedFiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping snapshotted files badge opens mobile-optimized unified diff view.
Supports direct one-tap rollback from inside the diff modal.

tasks.title: One-Tap Git Commit & Push Action from Mobile Turn Card
tasks.description: Provide a one-tap Commit & Push button alongside Rollback on turns that modified workspace files.
tasks.spec: Add POST /antigravity/api/projects/:id/commit endpoint with semantic commit message generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Commits modified files in active workspace and pushes to origin.
Updates active git SHA badge in the top Workspace Pill.
